name: AI Influencer
summary: Makes a feed-ready photo of a made-up influencer in their niche, with natural skin (FLUX 3 Klein).

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/create-image's (built by tools/build_apps.py) without the 9B prompt upsampler (the prompt goes straight to the text encoder); the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it.

inputs.label: Who
inputs.default: a woman in her late twenties from Mexico City with curly dark hair
inputs.help: Describe a person who does not exist: age, origin, hair, style.

inputs.label: Niche
inputs.default: fitness influencer stretching on a rooftop at sunrise in workout clothes

options.value: fitness influencer stretching on a rooftop at sunrise in workout clothes
options.label: Fitness

options.value: travel influencer with a backpack at a viewpoint above a coastal town
options.label: Travel

options.value: fashion influencer posing on a city street in a tailored camel coat
options.label: Fashion

options.value: food influencer tasting a dish at a busy street food stall at night
options.label: Food

options.value: tech influencer at a desk with a laptop and a camera on a tripod, warm desk lamp
options.label: Tech

inputs.label: Extra direction
inputs.help: Added at the end of the app's prompt.

bind.template: A vertical phone photo for a social media feed of {who}, a {niche}. Natural skin texture with visible pores, candid moment, realistic photo, no text, no logos. {details}

test.niche: fitness influencer stretching on a rooftop at sunrise in workout clothes
